limitations: Sequential diagnostic runs, not a registered acceptance cohort.
Instrumented phase durations overlap and are not additive.
The broad lstat monkeypatch changes more than the storage-binding owner; only the subsequent module-specific load hook isolates that candidate.
Parsed-manifest prototype holds one value; production uses separately tested bounded expiry and eviction.
Fresh processes do not imply cold OS caches; resident workloads remain uncontrolled.
